name: kae
description: KAE — Knowledge Acquisition Engine for the Axiom ecosystem

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @scooper/core && npm run build -w @scooper/parser && npm run build -w @scooper/capability-engine && npm run build -w @scooper/exporters && npm run build -w @scooper/connector-engine && npm run build -w @scooper/importers && npm run build -w @scooper/repository-engine && npm run build -w @scooper/source-engine && npm run build -w @scooper/graph
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @scooper/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @scooper/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
